headline: One photo, 204 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 8227d019a8e2) is attached to 204 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 204 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (201), Other (3).
All 204 works started and ended on the same day (2026-05-24).
